scripts.build:demo: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode demo && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFile, cp } from 'node:fs/promises'; await copyFile('../dist-demo/index.html', '../dist-demo/404.html'); await copyFile('../docs/tour.html', '../dist-demo/tour.html'); await cp('../docs/screenshots', '../dist-demo/screenshots', { recursive: true });"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false
